predecessors.name: New Zealand
predecessors.text: Western Samoa: 'the two large islands of Upolu and Savai'i' and 'two smaller, inhabited islands (Manono and Apolima)'

ledger.x: 1962: Western Samoa becomes independent: 'Western Samoa gained independence on 1 January 1962'; the page says the New Zealand Western Samoa Act of 24 November 1961 'terminated the Trusteeship Agreement' and 'granted the country independence as the Independent State of Western Samoa, effective 1 January 1962'.
1997: Western Samoa becomes Samoa: 'On 4 July 1997, the government amended the constitution to change the name of the country from Western Samoa to Samoa'.

certainty.note: An island group; the border is the coast.
